sections.text: Bow of the Tempest Wing XL

[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 4XL.
Target: yourself. Recovers 10 Cost.
Restores 10% of damage dealt as HP.
Increases physical and magic attack Ability success value by M.
Ability Power scales with the number of Bow type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 5XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Bow type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
